pr_title: Moving CSI Node storage version to v1
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
When promoting the CSI Driver to GA [Issue 88821](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/88821) was filed. I believe that this PR addresses it by removing the `LockToDefault` feature gate for CSI Nodes. I've also updated the test that I found which uses the v1beta1 version of the CSINodes.

Please let me know what else is required to address this issue.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #88821

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
NONE
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:
```docs

```

issue_context.title: Switch storage version to use v1.CSIDriver in 1.19
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added:**
storage/v1.CSINode is being introduced in 1.17 via PR #84814 . The storage version should switch to v1 in 1.19.

**Why is this needed:**
We need to wait until 1.19 to handle the HA upgrade case where a controller may be 1 version higher than the API server.
